name: Zanma Rouga
source:
Rouga is a man with a strong sense of justice who enjoys a good fight and fine women. With a strong body and great reflexes, he seeks to dominate the entire nation.

He was trained by his older brother, [url=/c369]Zanma Gou[/url]. And while Rouga often is annoyed by Gou's antics and tend to punch him into oblivion, he does heed his brother's advice and show a degree of respect for him.

Rouga is betrothed to [url=/c371]Tenrou Kunagi[/url], and cares quite a bit for her. Although that does not seem to stop him from loving other women as well. 

[Edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
